neighbors.identifier: arXiv 2303.14186 (Park et al., TRAK: Attributing Model Behavior at Scale, ICML 2023)
neighbors.establishing_passage: By leveraging only a handful of trained models, TRAK can match the performance of attribution methods that require training thousands of models. ... demonstrated across various modalities and scales: image classifiers trained on ImageNet, vision-language models (CLIP), and language models (BERT and mT5).

neighbors.identifier: OpenReview forum 13VkFDTKHH (Data Attribution for Segmentation Models, NeurIPS 2023 submission; PDF blob e15a148b35fbb56da1af7d88c7c66add68615a6a)
neighbors.establishing_passage: The authors identify specific behaviors of these models to attribute and provide a method for computing such attributions efficiently ... leveraged them to both identify harmful labeling errors and curate a 50% subset of the MS COCO training dataset that leads to a 2.79% +/- 0.49% increase in mIOU over the full dataset.

neighbors.identifier: DOI 10.1038/s41598-021-87762-2, PMID 33863957 (Data valuation for medical imaging using Shapley value, Scientific Reports 2021)
neighbors.establishing_passage: Removing training data with high Shapley values decreased the pneumonia detection performance, whereas removing data with low Shapley values improved the model performance.
